contracts.claim: Empty or malformed stores create and persist the primary workspace. Existing release roots reanchor within their release family; unrelated project roots remain unchanged. The returned projection equals durable state.

Workspace removal preserves unrelated workspaces, missions and history, removes only the selected workspace mission projection/history, and returns the exact removal count. The last workspace and unknown IDs are rejected by the action.

Each workspace has exactly one eligible active slot, contiguous queued positions and actual blocker identities. Completed, blocked and exhausted owners release their queue position; newly promoted queued work receives its front-of-queue receipt.
Event reads return only the requested durable tail in newest-first order, skip malformed rows and obey zero/negative bounds.
Unchanged file metadata reuses the same cached parse object; new small parses enter the cache and durable writes invalidate stale cached values.
Desktop Focus/Autopilot/Deep Run/Research modes select fast/autopilot/deep_run/swarms engines, with autopilot for unknown vocabulary.
Mission titles remove prompt filler, preserve significant words in order, omit secondary stopwords, capitalize the opening token, bound length to six tokens and use New Mission for empty input.

File scopes are bounded, deduplicated normalized paths. Explicit artifact destinations and fusion workspaces are retained, while separately labelled source projects and validation prose do not become edit targets.

Runtime budget values are nonnegative; an explicit persisted deadline determines maximum duration, elapsed and remaining time over the nominal duration, while recorded running continuation windows retain their established precedence.

Failed verification labels structured checks by checkId/id/label/title/message/detail/status priority and reports at most two, rather than rendering mapping representations as user-facing failure names.
Image artifact summaries match retained items, direct files retain their stem identity, and previews bind to existing sufficiently sized artifact files.

Verifier screenshots/reports are confined to the supplied workspace, copied byte faithfully and stored beside a durable manifest with exact schema/count/size. External paths are rejected and cannot publish an attachment manifest.
An existing embedded Windows runtime evidence path is recovered to that actual file rather than retaining the malformed prefix.

Recorded first-view proof can satisfy interface evidence. Completed/real-output evidence and clean advancing cadence determine output/red-team requirements. Weighted counts, completion percentage and top blocker agree with actual requirement rows; missing mission output remains partial.

Quiet completed queues with an explicit healthy queue receipt are not a missing-live-work gap. Clean advancing red-team cadence stays visible as zero-loss maintenance; unhealthy cadence retains a positive product gap. Loss averages match recorded category scores.

An unmeasured connect/timeout failure produces a warning rather than a measured full-disk block. Triage executes no destructive action; this projection consumes recorded pressure input without probing NAS.
A mission preview uses its actual artifact manifest, explicit entrypoint or bare index.html; absent files provide no fabricated preview.

A current live-view URL takes precedence over a persisted artifact manifest. Without a live-view URL, the mission artifact binds into the proof digest with its correct source label. URL binding alone is not serving/browser proof.

Mission progress uses recorded actions/runtime lanes, treats failed work as bounded proof repair, queued work as four-percent queued state, and exhausted work as non-completion attention. Fresh/extended active windows preserve an activity floor and renewed denominator; planned artifact counts match measured local entries.

Pure mission lifecycle counters distinguish active, blocked, queued and runtime-budget attention from persisted mission facts. Startup checks do not prove full summary aggregate wiring; its two original cases remain retained.

Every shell collector uses the same actual active/queued workspace ownership projection. Eligible queue owners exclude released, exhausted and reconcile-pending missions; queue IDs and counts match recorded rows.

Only useful operator-scored feedback reduces missing route-value samples. Low-value closeouts require prioritized artifact/browser/proof/value repair, with explicit model policy. Declared sample objectives outrank unrelated workspace route defaults.

Release quality uses bounded completed-or-continuing and resume-completed-or-continuing components while preserving terminal completion statistics. This calculation does not collect release/supervisor state.

Notification rows refer only to current mission IDs and are bounded. Completed concrete runtime output yields a source-labelled slice, while running output can hydrate from the mission’s local runtime ledger; no provider discovery is needed.

Mission-only overnight projection separates actionable repair from safely held overlap queues, preserving owner identity, repair/held counts and split-scope guidance. Delivery/channel collection remains outside the scratch projector.

Tracked branches expose fast-forward-only pull and scoped commit suggestions. Approval-gated pull remains gated and action order is inspect, pull, commit, push. Projection never executes git pull/push.
The workspace exposes one real validation action on validate.workspace, including the frontend build command detected from local package.json. Projection does not execute that declared command.

Successful atomic writes equal the submitted JSON. The Windows startup procedure holds a real read lease denying delete-sharing, releases it while the production retry loop runs, verifies exact durable content, preserves an unrelated keeper and leaves no staging file.

Harness summary counts only mission-index sessions and explicitly defers unrelated runtime history. Terminal completion, live continuity and resumed completion/continuity rates retain distinct denominators.

Mission-loop projection preserves persisted enforced run-until behavior and budget state. An unacknowledged completed delegated lane becomes resume-available with reconciliation guidance instead of active-running continuity.
